limits: PROFILE ON single complete request, no explicit fixture warmup, not a production speed benchmark.
Only ggml-spacemit operator intervals are captured. CPU fallback/copies, host time, graph gaps and sampling are excluded.
Per-operator worker intervals are unioned, never summed across seven workers.
Initialization graphs excluded by two result_output boundaries; decode validated against predicted_n-1.
Packing/compute/barriers inside each operator are not individually separated.

stress.scope: serial mixed seven-case soak; CPU/memory sampled every 3 seconds, not a concurrent-client throughput test; embeddings cover saved last slice only; no general Q4/Q8 accuracy equivalence

stress_preflight.reason: Replace strict logger-stage timing gate with separate phase-timing availability before formal soak; complete preflight evidence retained; SIGTERM handler restores original service

cache_configuration_supplement.scope: Two-arm OFF(default cache)/ON(cache-ram0) exploratory supplement, 3 formal per state per case. Less drift control than four-arm ABBA. Same final v47 kernels and cache_prompt=false; all E2E retained. No claim of disabling every KV/media cache, no long-soak validation of cache-ram0.

extra_tables.scope: four GT cases, one request per state; reports OCR/structure errors as measured, never corrects output

limits: Saved embeddings cover the final vision slice only.
Exact optimization parity does not establish Q4/Q8/FP16 accuracy equivalence.
Microbenchmark percentages are not whole-request gains.
